rows.quote: RICHARD J. ALLAIN - Upon his discharge from the service, "Dick" was hired as a teacher of grade six in September 1956. In September 1967, he was transferred to the high school as a teacher of science, including electronics. After 25 years of service, Dick chose to take advantage of an "early retirement" and retired on June 30, 1981.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: FLOYD F. BARNEY - Floyd began September 1, 1947 and retired June 30, 1981 after 34 years of service with the Lunenburg Public Schools. During his tenure he served as a teacher, girls' and boys' basketball coach, baseball coach, softball coach, Supervisor of Physical Education, Assistant High School Principal, and Principal of the Turkey Hill Middle School.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: BEATRICE M. BROWN - "Bea" began her service with Lunenburg on March 1, 1945 and retired effective June 30, 1971 after completion of nearly 26 years as a first grade teacher with classes held in the Town Hall, Center School, Brooks House, and Passios Elementary School over the span of her service.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: GLADYS L. BROWN - Gladys began in September 1931 as a first grade teacher in the old Center School and remained in this position until June 1938 when she resigned to be married. She returned in November 1948 when Lunenburg schools went on double sessions to teach a combination grade two and three class. In September 1949, Gladys was transferred to the Brooks House to teach a grade four. She was appointed as
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: RICHARD J. CAREY - Dick began September 1, 1946 and retired June 30, 1981 after 35 years of service as a teacher, baseball and basketball coach, Assistant High School Principal, and Principal of Lunenburg High School.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: NELDE K. DRUMM - "Tiz" began in Lunenburg on September 17, 1955 as an art teacher at the high school for one day per week; increased to three days per week in September 1957 and in September 1958, to full-time as Art Supervisor for the school system. She retired on June 30, 1977 after completing 22 years of service.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: PRISCILLA A. FREEMAN - "Pat" joined the elementary staff on September 1, 1964 as physical education instructor. After 20 years of service, she chose to retire on June 30, 1984. 139
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: LILLIAN S. GRIFFITHS - "Lil" began her teaching career as a junior high teacher in the old high school (now the Primary School) on September 1, 1941. She resigned in June 1944 to be married. In February 1950, she returned as a fifth grade teacher and in September 1957 was appointed as Supervisor of Reading and Allied Subjects. "Lil" retired on June 30, 1977 after 301 years of service.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: MARGARET P. HARLEY - Margaret began in Lunenburg in September 1932 as a junior high teacher. She was appointed effective September 1, 1958 as Guidance Director at Lunenburg High School and retired from this position on July 13, 1969, completing 35 plus years with the Lunenburg Public Schools. She had an outstanding record as coach of the girls' basketball team during her tenure and is regarded as the local
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: M. NOREEN KITTREDGE - Noreen came to Lunenburg in September 1953 as a teacher of grade one; resigned in June 1955, but returned in January 1960 to complete the school year in a third grade. The following September she transferred to grade one, remaining at this grade level until her retirement on June 30, 1984 after 261 years of service.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: ELIZABETH LAKSO - Betty began in Lunenburg on February 29, 1960 as a teacher of grade two. She took advantage of an "early retirement" and retired on June 30, 1981 after 211 years of service.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: GLORIA V. MacPHADDEN - Gloria was hired in September 1957 as a home economics teacher in the newly built high school. She completed 21 years of service before she retired on June 30, 1978.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: SALLY A. McCUE - In September 1959, Sally was hired as a teacher of grade five. She served as Annex Building Supervisor for nearly five years. At the time of her retirement on June 30, 1984, she was teaching a fourth grade at the elementary school, completing 25 years of service.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: MARGARET M. SHEEHAN - "Peg" began teaching in Lunenburg in September 1942 as teacher of grades one, two, three combination at the old West School in Whalom. In 1953, Peg was transferred to the new Passios Elementary School as a teacher of grade one and remained in that position until June 30, 1972 when she retired after completing 30 years of service.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: SIRKKA W. SHINNER - Sirkka came to Lunenburg in September 1959 as a second grade teacher when an additional section was needed. She remained at this grade level until her retirement on June 18, 1982 after 23 years of service.
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.

rows.quote: BETHEL E. TAPPLY - "Beth" began in September 1958 as a teacher of junior high English. During her 24 years in Lunenburg, she also served as a high school guidance counselor, Director of Guidance, and as the school system's School Psychologist. She retired on June 18, 1982. 140
rows.note: Heading of a narrative or list entry as printed; the quote is the first lines of the entry.
